tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Page background for both apps. A cool lilac grey, never cream.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, sheets, the composer, the brief panel.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: the quote block, the transcript strip, input fields at rest.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3.2:1 on paper in light, 3.3:1 in dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on fog, paper and paper-sunk (16:1+ in both themes). Fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders on fog and paper (6:1+ light, 7:1+ dark).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button, ink chips).

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The Envoi pink. The Echo, the record action, the one moment that matters per view. Graphics and fills only, never text on fog.

tokens.name: pulse-edge
tokens.usage: Pink as text or a 1px edge: links, active tab underline, the border on a pulse fill so it clears 3:1 on fog (5.2:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-pulse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pulse fill (5.8:1 light, 7:1 dark). Never white.

tokens.name: pulse-wash
tokens.usage: Soft pink ground for a selected option or the recording state. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: zest
tokens.usage: Money and rewards only: the earnings chip, payout receipts, points. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: zest-deep
tokens.usage: Dollar amounts written as text on paper (6.4:1 light, 14:1 dark).

tokens.name: zest-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for a payout receipt card. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Researcher data: second series in charts, segment tags, links in reports (4.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark on paper).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Passed quality checks, filled quotas. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Slow fill, expiring soon, needs review. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Removed responses, payment failed, errors. Always with a word or icon; differs from good in lightness too.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (5.2:1 on fog light, 7.8:1 dark).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Real customers, before your next move.
styles.usage: One per page at most: marketing heroes, the respondent welcome, the payout moment.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: The interview question on the respondent screen (32px under 400px wide).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in the researcher app.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Price felt fair until delivery fees

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Counts on the tracking page and the earnings total. Always tabular numbers.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles and labels for groups of fields.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Tell us about the last time you ordered snacks online.
styles.usage: Respondent body copy and agent messages on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Most people mentioned delivery fees before price.
styles.usage: Default text in both apps. Inputs are 16px so iOS never zooms.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, tags, button text in dense UI. Sentence case, never all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, chip inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to field, chip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button inner padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gutters on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Around the Echo, between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top padding on desktop, hero breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, quote wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the invite card, the interview stage.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the earnings pill, progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating cards: the invite card, the brief panel, sheets. Flat cards use a line edge instead.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Primary and pulse buttons, so they read as pressable objects next to the 3D Echo.
